scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 9-UNIT MAShQLAR, 2-BET (46-bet, PDF 45). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '9'.

CHAP USTUN:
4) 'Use the prompts to make sentences in the passive, as in the example.' 1 the ironing/share/Suzanne and David → The ironing is shared by Suzanne and David. 2 the house/clean/next weekend 3 the fence/paint/last Tuesday 4 the invitations/just/send 5 the stolen painting/not find/yet 6 the clothes/wash/tomorrow 7 the doctor/already/call 8 the washing-up/do/Joseph/every night
5) 'Using the passive voice, expand the signs, notices and advertisements in the table to fill in the gaps in the sentences below, as in the example.' E'LONLAR: A BREAKFAST SERVED 6 AM - 11 AM; B ENGLISH TEACHERS WANTED; C VOLUNTEERS NEEDED; D STORE CLOSED; E SPEED CHECKED BY RADAR. 1 Breakfast is served from 6 am to 11 am at the Sunnyside Diner every morning. 2 It is a national holiday tomorrow and ...... 3 ...... at the Children's Hospital for weekends. 4 ...... on the highway leading from Providence to Boston. 5 ...... at the International Language School for the next school year.

O'NG USTUN:
6) 'First match the pictures to the sentences then rewrite the sentences in the passive as in the example.' RASMLAR: a Sir Alexander Fleming (keksa erkak); b eggs (tuxumlar qutisi); c a kettle (choynak); d endangered species (kit, panda, fil); e a frying pan (tova); f Charlie Chaplin; g rockets (raketa); h architects (chizma chizayotgan ayol). 1 c We boil water in it. → Water is boiled in it/a kettle. 2 He discovered penicillin. 3 People will use them to travel in space in the future. 4 They design buildings. 5 He entertained thousands of people. 6 You can fry chips in it. 7 We should save these animals. 8 Hens lays them.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '46'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to make sentences in the passive, as in the example. 1 the ironing/share/Suzanne and David → The ironing is shared by Suzanne and David. 2 the house/clean/next weekend 3 the fence/paint/last Tuesday 4 the invitations/just/send 5 the stolen painting/not find/yet 6 the clothes/wash/tomorrow 7 the doctor/already/call 8 the washing-up/do/Joseph/every night
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib majhul nisbatda gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 the ironing/share/Suzanne and David → Dazmol ishi Syuzanna va Devid o'rtasida bo'lishilgan. 2 the house/clean/next weekend 3 the fence/paint/last Tuesday 4 the invitations/just/send 5 the stolen painting/not find/yet 6 the clothes/wash/tomorrow 7 the doctor/already/call 8 the washing-up/do/Joseph/every night
exercises.explanationUz:
VAQT SO'ZI → ZAMON.

  1 is shared (odat) - NAMUNA
  2 will be cleaned (next weekend)
  3 was painted (last Tuesday)
  4 have just been sent (just →
    Present Perfect)
  5 hasn't been found yet (yet)
  6 will be washed (tomorrow)
  7 has already been called
    (already)
  8 is done by Joseph (every night)


⚠ 'JUST / ALREADY' O'RNI:

  have JUST been sent; has ALREADY
  been called - have/has va been
  orasida.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 The ironing is shared by Suzanne and David.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 Dazmol ishi Syuzanna va Devid o'rtasida bo'lishilgan.
modelAnswers: 1 The ironing is shared by Suzanne and David.
2 The house will be cleaned next weekend.
3 The fence was painted last Tuesday.

8 The washing-up is done by Joseph every night.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Dazmol ishi Syuzanna va Devid o'rtasida bo'lishilgan. (NAMUNA)
2 Uy keyingi dam olish kuni tozalanadi.
8 Idish yuvish har kecha Jozef tomonidan qilinadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Using the passive voice, expand the signs, notices and advertisements in the table to fill in the gaps in the sentences below, as in the example. Signs: A BREAKFAST SERVED 6 AM - 11 AM; B ENGLISH TEACHERS WANTED; C VOLUNTEERS NEEDED; D STORE CLOSED; E SPEED CHECKED BY RADAR.
exercises.instructionUz: E'lonlar va reklamalarni majhul nisbatda kengaytirib, quyidagi gaplardagi bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, namunadagidek. E'lonlar: A NONUShTA 6-11 DA BERILADI; B INGLIZ TILI O'QITUVChILARI KERAK; C KO'NGILLILAR KERAK; D DO'KON YOPIQ; E TEZLIK RADAR BILAN TEKShIRILADI.
exercises.explanationUz:
E'LONLAR - QISQARTIRILGAN MAJHUL.

  E'lonlarda 'to be' tushib qoladi.
  To'liq gap → is/are + V3:

  1 A: Breakfast IS SERVED (NAMUNA)
  2 D: the store IS CLOSED
    (tomorrow - 'will be closed'
    ham)
  3 C: Volunteers ARE NEEDED
  4 E: Speed IS CHECKED by radar
  5 B: English teachers ARE
    WANTED


⚠ 'VOLUNTEERS':

  = ko'ngillilar.


⚠ 'A DINER':

  = kichik restoran (AmE).

items.textEn: ___ at the Sunnyside Diner every morning. (A)
items.answer: Breakfast is served from 6 am to 11 am

items.textEn: It is a national holiday tomorrow and ___. (D)
items.whyUz: ⚠ STORE CLOSED → the store is closed ('will be closed' ham).

items.textEn: ___ at the Children's Hospital for weekends. (C)
___ on the highway leading from Providence to Boston. (E)
___ at the International Language School for the next school year. (B)

exercises.instructionEn: First match the pictures to the sentences then rewrite the sentences in the passive as in the example. Pictures: a Sir Alexander Fleming; b eggs; c a kettle; d endangered species; e a frying pan; f Charlie Chaplin; g rockets; h architects. 1 (c) We boil water in it. → Water is boiled in it/a kettle. 2 He discovered penicillin. 3 People will use them to travel in space in the future. 4 They design buildings. 5 He entertained thousands of people. 6 You can fry chips in it. 7 We should save these animals. 8 Hens lays them.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval rasmlarni gaplarga moslang, so'ng gaplarni majhul nisbatda qayta yozing, namunadagidek. Rasmlar: a ser Aleksandr Fleming; b tuxumlar; c choynak; d yo'qolib borayotgan turlar; e tova; f Charli Chaplin; g raketalar; h arxitektorlar. 1 (c) Biz unda suv qaynatamiz. → Suv unda / choynakda qaynatiladi. 2 U penitsillinni kashf etdi. 3 Kelajakda odamlar ular bilan kosmosga sayohat qilishadi. 4 Ular binolarni loyihalaydi. 5 U minglab odamlarni quvontirdi. 6 Unda kartoshka qovurish mumkin. 7 Biz bu hayvonlarni saqlab qolishimiz kerak. 8 Tovuqlar ularni tug'adi.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASM + MAJHUL.

  1 c - Water is boiled in a kettle.
    (NAMUNA)
  2 a - Penicillin was discovered
    by Sir Alexander Fleming.
  3 g - Rockets will be used to
    travel in space in the future.
  4 h - Buildings are designed by
    architects.
  5 f - Thousands of people were
    entertained by Charlie Chaplin.
  6 e - Chips can be fried in a
    frying pan.
  7 d - Endangered species should
    be saved.
  8 b - Eggs are laid by hens.

  ⚠ 'it / them / he' o'rniga rasm
  nomini yozing.
  ⚠ Kitobda 'Hens lays' - matbaa
  xatosi (lay).


⚠ 'PENICILLIN':

  = penitsillin (antibiotik, 1928).


⚠ 'TO LAY EGGS':

  = tuxum tug'moq (lay - laid).
exercises.exampleEn: 1 (c) Water is boiled in it / a kettle.
modelAnswers: 1 (c) Water is boiled in a kettle.
2 (a) Penicillin was discovered by Sir Alexander Fleming.
3 (g) Rockets will be used to travel in space in the future.
5 (f) Thousands of people were entertained by Charlie Chaplin.
6 (e) Chips can be fried in a frying pan.
modelAnswersUz: 2 (a) Penitsillin ser Aleksandr Fleming tomonidan kashf etilgan.
3 (g) Kelajakda raketalar kosmosga sayohat qilish uchun ishlatiladi.
5 (f) Minglab odamlar Charli Chaplin tomonidan quvontirilgan.
6 (e) Kartoshka tovada qovurilishi mumkin. (can be fried)
7 (d) Yo'qolib borayotgan turlar saqlab qolinishi kerak. (should be saved)

patterns.formula: NIMA + has just / already been + V3 / hasn't been + V3 + yet
patterns.exampleEn: The invitations have just been sent. The stolen painting hasn't been found yet.
patterns.exampleUz: Taklifnomalar endigina yuborildi. O'g'irlangan rasm hali topilmagan.

patterns.exampleEn: VOLUNTEERS NEEDED → Volunteers are needed at the Children's Hospital.
patterns.exampleUz: KO'NGILLILAR KERAK → Bolalar kasalxonasiga ko'ngillilar kerak.

patterns.exampleEn: Chips can be fried in a frying pan. Endangered species should be saved.
